Mira is an archivist who grew up with [[Theo]]. She was born in winter :canon[during the long frost]{tier=maybe}.

## Early life

:::canon{tier=soft}
She learned to read from the guild's ledgers.
:::

> [!tip] Writing note
> Keep her **quiet** in group scenes.

> [!warning]- Spoilers
> She leaves the guild in book two.

## Personality

:::pressure
Triggers: Being talked over.
Coping: Counts exits, then jokes.
  Never in front of [[Theo]].
Contradictions: Craves order, keeps a messy desk.
Breaking point: Losing the archive.
How others read it: Calm.
Aftermath: Sleeps for a day.
:::

- Patient
- Stubborn
